assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one full-frame 16:9 cinematic CG for the Japanese anime game Refrain, no panels. New scene: a quiet close group at eye level inside the tall reflective glass hall, blue-violet damaged panes beginning to admit pale amber light, no action. Four characters ONLY. Left Akari, blonde short low ponytail, violet eyes, cream cardigan white office shirt blue ID lanyard, kneeling slightly and speaking gently. Center-left Koharu, brown shoulder length hair small gold clip, amber eyes, navy school blazer and purple ribbon, attentive. Behind them real-world Rei, short dark navy bob, violet eyes, gray hoodie white shirt, calm not her long-haired VTuber avatar. Right Mina sits exhausted but listening, long BLACK hair, blue eyes, white maid headband, navy-white modest maid dress and rectangular blue brooch. Her black hair and cuff retain a few small ink-like stains from the battle, no gore or exposed body, no thorn monster. Mina is looking at Akari, not camera; friends wait at her eye level instead of looming over her. Their hands rest naturally near Mina, no grabbing, no magical light ball in front, no UI. Express relief through restrained faces and close attention, not exaggerated smiles or tears. Cinematic medium framing: all four complete heads and shoulders within x=8%-92%, y=14%-50%; important hands within y=45%-63%. Bottom 28% is plain natural floor/clothing continuation for in-game subtitle overlay, not a painted text box; top 10% quiet background. Crisp controlled detailed Japanese anime/visual-novel illustration, precisely match reference 2/3, not photorealism, not 3D, not chibi, no lens blur, no text, no logos, no borders, no collage, no watermark.
